title: A reading list from data
task: Render `books` as two lists: "Up next" for unfinished books and "Finished" for the rest. Each item reads "Title by Author" and has a stable key. A group with no books shows "Nothing here yet." instead of an empty list.
hints: Split the array first: `const upNext = books.filter((book) => !book.finished);` and the same for finished books.
Turn each group into list items with `map`, and use `book.id` as the `key`. The ID belongs to the book, so it stays the same however the list is sorted.
